$comment: Golden vectors for SPEC §3 config fingerprinting. Generated by packages/core/scripts/gen-fingerprint-vectors.mjs from the TypeScript reference implementation. packages/core and bench/atlas_bench/canonical.py must both reproduce every expected value exactly. Vectors sharing an equivalence_group must produce the same config_id.

vectors.name: empty-args
vectors.description: No flags at all still produces a non-empty canonical string: the two pseudo-params.

vectors.name: alias-resolution-short-flag
vectors.description: -tp resolves to tensor-parallel-size via the version file aliases.

vectors.name: alias-resolution-canonical-name
vectors.description: Writing the canonical name gives the identical fingerprint as the alias.

vectors.name: default-dropping
vectors.description: gpu-memory-utilization=0.9 and tensor-parallel-size=1 are this version defaults, so they vanish.

vectors.name: default-dropping-omitted
vectors.description: Omitting the defaults entirely is the same configuration.

vectors.name: float-normalization-number
vectors.description: 0.44 as a JSON number.

vectors.name: float-normalization-trailing-zero-string
vectors.description: "0.4400" from a shell command line is the same value as 0.44.

vectors.name: float-normalization-0.90-equals-0.9
vectors.description: "0.90" normalizes to 0.9, which is this version default, so the flag drops out entirely.

vectors.name: bool-normalization-native
vectors.description: A real boolean.

vectors.name: bool-normalization-string-True
vectors.description: Python-style "True" from an env var or a YAML file.

vectors.name: bool-normalization-one
vectors.description: 1 is true for a flag the version file declares boolean.

vectors.name: nested-object-arg
vectors.description: speculative-config is an object; its keys are sorted, not reordered by luck.

vectors.name: nested-object-arg-as-json-string
vectors.description: The same object as it arrives from a shell command line.

vectors.name: array-arg-sorted
vectors.description: Array elements are sorted, so element order cannot fork the fingerprint.

vectors.name: array-arg-other-order
vectors.description: Same array, written the other way round.

vectors.name: unknown-engine-version-drops-no-defaults
vectors.description: With no version file we do not know what a default is, so nothing is dropped — including values that would be defaults on a known version.

vectors.name: drop-params-model-and-port
vectors.description: Paths, ports and served names cannot change a number, so they never reach the hash.

vectors.name: key-ordering-independence-a
vectors.description: Flags written in one order.

vectors.name: key-ordering-independence-b
vectors.description: The same three flags written in the opposite order.

vectors.name: underscore-to-dash
vectors.description: max_model_len from a Python config is the same flag as --max-model-len.

vectors.name: leading-dashes-stripped
vectors.description: Copy-pasting the flag with its dashes must not fork the fingerprint.

vectors.name: uppercase-key-lowercased
vectors.description: Flag names are case-insensitive for fingerprinting purposes.

vectors.name: null-value-is-not-a-flag
vectors.description: A null value means the flag was not passed; it must not appear in the fingerprint.

vectors.name: unknown-flag-kept-verbatim
vectors.description: A flag the version file has never heard of is kept, normalized but not dropped — new flags must not silently collide.

vectors.name: quant-and-dtype-pseudo-params
vectors.description: The pseudo-params sort first because "@" is below "a" in byte order.

vectors.name: llamacpp-short-flags
vectors.description: llama.cpp aliases: -c, -ngl, -np. -b 2048 is the default and drops out.

vectors.name: llamacpp-long-flags
vectors.description: The same llama.cpp configuration written with long flag names.

vectors.name: engine-level-param-aliases
vectors.description: engine meta param_aliases apply on top of the per-param aliases.

vectors.name: fork-build-a
vectors.description: Two forks can share a version string: `0.1.dev20073+g8e685d198` names the UPSTREAM commit the fork branched from, not the fork's patches. @build is what separates them.

vectors.name: fork-build-b
vectors.description: Same fork, later commit. The prefix-caching fix landed between these two refs, so they are materially different engines behind one version string and must not share a fingerprint.

vectors.name: no-build-is-omitted
vectors.description: A result that declares no build hashes exactly as it did before @build existed, so every id recorded to date stays valid.
